findings.message: All available GITHUB_TOKEN permissions are writable.
findings.recommendation: Declare only the individual permissions required by this scope.

findings.message: Remote dependency reference is mutable or lacks an immutable pin.
findings.recommendation: Pin the remote action or reusable workflow to a verified full commit SHA.

findings.message: Privileged pull_request_target workflow checks out pull-request head input.
findings.recommendation: Keep untrusted pull-request code in an unprivileged workflow; review any subsequent execution.

findings.message: Event input is interpolated directly into script source.
findings.recommendation: Pass untrusted input via env and quote the shell variable; review transformations and shell usage.

findings.message: An echo command directly references a secret expression; inspect its output destination.
findings.recommendation: Avoid printing secret values. Log masking does not guarantee redaction of transformed data.
